name: Sold Out Frontier ~Reifu-tachi no Kihin Shakou Ressha~
original_name: SOLD OUT FRONTIER ～隷婦達の貴賓社交列車～
source:
Local nobleman Selena excavates a huge vehicle from ancient ruins. She turned it into a train, built a small town in it and laid tracks for it to move. The established club "Renaissance" inside it becomes a gathering place for all nobles, but underneath presents a prostitution slave camp. Main character is put in charge of training slaves for sex.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/04/vn-of-month-september-2002-masaru.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
当地贵族塞莱娜从古代遗迹中挖出一辆巨型车辆。她把它改造成火车，在车上建造小镇，并铺设轨道。里面成立的“文艺复兴”俱乐部成为所有贵族的聚会场所，然而地下却是卖淫奴隶营。主人公被安排负责训练奴隶进行性爱。

[来源：[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/04/vn-of-month-september-2002-masaru.html]vndbreview[/url]]
